name: CollectionQueue
description: Tasks (משימות): one row per problem that needs handling, keyed by taskKey. Written by the 06:00 task scan (aging), the inbox and the receipts flow; closed automatically when the problem is gone

columns.name: queueDate
columns.description: Queue date

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: assignedBookkeeperName
columns.description: Assigned bookkeeper

columns.name: priorityScore
columns.description: Priority score

columns.name: reasons
columns.description: Short Hebrew list of why the customer is in today's queue (long text)

columns.name: recommendedAction
columns.description: Recommended action

columns.name: status
columns.description: Queue item status

columns.name: handledBy
columns.description: Who handled it

columns.name: handledAt
columns.description: When it was handled

columns.name: taskType
columns.description: Task type
enum: לברר מול הלקוח – סכום לא סוגר חודש

columns.name: itemsJson
columns.description: Grouped tasks (plan 04.11): one task per note type + date + bookkeeper (taskKey notes:<type>:<date>:<bookkeeper>), one item per customer + month. An item leaves when its month's balance reaches 0 or a person marks it handled; the task closes when no items are left

promised.description: Promised amount (commitments) or the note amount

outcome.description: קוימה חלקית / לא קוימה for commitments

columns.name: isAlert
columns.description: True for notices with nothing to do (e.g. נסגר לאפס): shown under the התראות filter, without a handle button. Writers always set it

columns.name: needsManagerApproval
columns.description: True when the task must be approved by a manager (e.g. a receipt whose match is not one-to-one). Writers always set it

columns.name: relatedTable
columns.description: Table of the record the task is about

columns.name: relatedId
columns.description: Id of the related record, as text

columns.name: dueAt
columns.description: When the task is due

columns.name: taskKey
columns.description: Unique key per problem, e.g. aging-overdue:<invoiceNumber>, promise-broken:<promiseId>, inbox:<emailId>, draft:<approvalId>, receipt-customer:<bankLineId>. Writers upsert by it, so a problem has one task

columns.name: title
columns.description: Short Hebrew title shown in the tasks list

columns.name: severity
columns.description: Severity level

columns.name: severityScore
columns.description: Severity score 0–100 (higher first): weighted amount and days overdue, weights and level thresholds from AgentSettings (severityWeightAmount, severityWeightDays, severityScoreCritical/High/Medium)

columns.name: source
columns.description: Which part of the app opened the task

columns.name: invoiceNumbers
columns.description: Invoice numbers the task is about, comma-separated (text links to Invoices)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount at stake ILS

columns.name: openedAt
columns.description: When the task was first opened (stays the same while the problem lasts)

columns.name: lastCheckedAt
columns.description: When a writer or the daily scan last confirmed the problem is still there

columns.name: resolvedAt
columns.description: When the task was closed (by a person or automatically)

columns.name: resolvedReason
columns.description: Why it was closed: the person's short note, or the automatic reason (e.g. the invoice was paid)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
